mechanism: Moxifloxacin may increase infection risk in patients receiving etanercept (TNF-alpha inhibitor) due to additive immunosuppression, and fluoroquinolones can rarely cause tendon rupture which may be potentiated by TNF inhibitors.
action: Monitor closely for signs of infection; use moxifloxacin only when clearly indicated and consider alternative antibiotics if possible; educate patient on tendon rupture symptoms.
